follow-up time: From birth of first child (caesarean section between 2008-2015) until the end of the subsequent pregnancy, or censorship at the end of 2015
outcome: Spontaneous preterm birth less than 37 weeks gestation
cohort: Women who delivered by emergency caesarean section between 2008-2015 at a university hospital and had a subsequent pregnancy in this timeframe (n=1557)
finding: Caesarean section at full cervical dilation did not increase the odds of spontaneous preterm birth in a subsequent pregnancy; however, a short interpregnancy interval of less than one year was associated with an increased risk of spontaneous preterm birth.
